spec.kitLine: Sea Breeze: DEF -1.9% of user's DEF
spec.assertion: No engine channel exists for reducing the BOSS's DEF (defPct is inert in v1; damageTakenPct is a different mechanic — a multiplier, not a flat DEF subtraction). Belongs in `unmodeled`. Test asserts the nearest-wrong fudge is ABSENT: no damageTakenPct buffApply with value ~1.9 or ~95. The only modelable consequence — the named status window that gates Storm — is covered by the Storm gate test.

it.skip. Engine has hitCount (every N hits) but no CRIT-gated counter. hitCount:2 over-applies stacks by ~1/critRate; faithful approximation is hitCount = round(2 / effective crit rate) — a flagged estimate. Not discriminable blind (Storm damage is the only observable and has no ground truth).

spec.kitLine: stacks up to 50, lasts for 3 sec
spec.assertion: Per-stack 3s decay has no primitive; steady-state stacks = (crit rate x fire rate / 2) x 3s, far below the 50 cap, so the cap is never the binding constraint. Flagged. Indirectly exercised by the stack-mirroring test (slowing the trigger must strictly reduce Storm).

Asserts the buff exists, is continuous (expiresFrame undefined or >= 10000), and hits exactly 3 units incl. mast. Fails under: (a) omitted entirely — the sim has no HP pool so an "HP < 70%" gate can never fire, but omitting under-credits mast's whole-fight support value in a real raid; (b) modeled with a durationSec. FLAG: the ONSET delay (a real fight takes seconds to drop below 70%) is unmodeled and unmeasured.

spec.kitLine: self and 2 other allies, highest final ATK
spec.assertion: Target set size is exactly 3 and CONTAINS mast. Fails under alliesTopAtk{count:2, excludeSelf:true} alone (exclude-then-take-N yields 2 allies and DROPS the caster) and under a plain `allies` target (4). Also asserted equal to the skill2 target set (identical kit wording). Note: byFinalAtk:true is required by the literal wording ("final ATK") but is not blind-discriminable in this fixture.

Exactly 3 buffApply events for the whole fight (one per target), expiresFrame in [1750,1850] (= 30s x 60fps from a frame-0 apply). Fails under: permanent modeling (expiresFrame undefined/>=10800), and under fullBurstEnter/interval re-keying (many applies, count > 3).

spec.kitLine: Activates at the start of battle
spec.assertion: Covered by the same test — a start-of-battle one-shot means exactly one apply per target AND a 1800-frame expiry; a refreshing trigger breaks the count, a permanent one breaks the expiry.

spec.kitLine: Max HP +86.2% of user's Max HP
spec.assertion: maxHpFlat applies from mast to 3 targets with ONE identical flat value. Fails under targetMaxHpPct ("Max HP +86.2%" of each target's own HP), which resolves per-target and emits differing values. Also asserts expiresFrame set matches the crit-damage line (same 7s block). Caveat: degenerate if all 3 targets share a Max HP value.

Requires NO heal effect on the block (a heal would emit recovery events and drive a teammate's on-recovery consumer, e.g. crown). Not directly observable — there is no recovery event kind — so recorded in the spec rather than asserted.

3 targets incl. mast, applies count divisible by 3, expiresFrame finite (< 10000) — fails under continuous modeling. Distinct expiresFrame stamps are >600 frames apart, which fails if the block were keyed to fullBurstEnter rather than her own burst cast.
totals(base) - totals(burst-damage-stripped) > 0 proves Storm is non-inert. Teammate totals byte-identical across the same pair proves it is enemy-only.

The load-bearing gate test: with skill1 emptied (no Sea Breeze source), stripping Storm changes mast's total by EXACTLY 0. Both sides of that delta lack skill1, so all non-Storm paths are identical and the delta isolates Storm. Fails under an ungated Storm (no requiresTargetStatus / no stack scaling), which still ticks 4.52% x7 per cast.

spec.kitLine: Mirrors the stack count of Sea Breeze
spec.assertion: Quartering the Sea Breeze trigger rate (hitCount.count x4 / interval.sec x4 / everyN x4) must STRICTLY reduce isolated Storm damage. Fails under a flat 4.52%-per-tick model (unchanged). Guarded by a SLOWED flag so a no-op mutation is recorded, not silently passed.

it.skip — tick cadence needs per-source damage-event attribution, and damage events are documented to carry srcSlot but no guaranteed source-slug field. Asserting on a guessed field name would risk a false RED on harness shape rather than model faithfulness.
Inertness: mast emits zero atkPct / casterAtkPct / highestAllyAtkPct / attackDamagePct / coreDamagePct buffs. Fails if a supporter's buffs were padded with an invented ATK grant.

fixtures: controlComp('mast', true) — liter(B1) / crown(B2) / mast(carry slot) / helm(B3) — for all skill1/skill2 assertions. MAIN FIXTURE HAZARD, surfaced deliberately: mast is BURST II and crown already occupies the B2 slot ahead of her, so the rotation may never select mast's own burst, which would make every burst assertion vacuous rather than discriminating. All burst-block runs therefore use an override clone with a `burstEligibility: 3` block appended to the burst slot — an accommodation that changes only WHEN she may cast, never WHAT her burst does, so it cannot manufacture any asserted value. The first test asserts that at least one of {unaided, accommodated} actually produces her burst buffs, so the burst section can never pass vacuously. 7 hoisted runs: base, fixture, fixture+no-Storm, fixture+no-Sea-Breeze, fixture+neither, fixture+slowed-Sea-Breeze, fixture+slowed+no-Storm. Storm is isolated by paired totals deltas rather than by damage-event attribution, so no undocumented event field is relied on. Slot-block access is written to handle BOTH documented override-clone shapes (bare Block[] vs CharacterSkills.blocks), since the packet's two descriptions disagree and a shape guess would otherwise produce a false RED.
gaps: skill1 Sea Breeze DEF-reduction payload — no engine StatKey reduces the BOSS's DEF (defPct is inert in v1; damageTakenPct is a different mechanic). Up to 50 x 1.9% = 95% of mast's DEF is a real team-wide damage gain the sim cannot represent; belongs in `unmodeled`. Only the named status window (Storm's gate) is modelable.

skill1 Sea Breeze trigger — 'after landing 2 CRITICAL hits with normal attacks' has no crit-gated counter primitive; hitCount:2 over-applies by ~1/critRate. Faithful approximation hitCount = round(2 / effective crit rate) is a FLAGGED estimate, not a kit value.

skill1 Sea Breeze stack decay — no per-stack 3s expiry primitive; steady-state stacks must be derived (crit rate x fire rate / 2 x 3s), which lands far below the 50 cap so the cap never binds. FLAGGED.

skill1 crit-damage trigger — 'Activates when HP falls below 70%' cannot be evaluated: the v1 sim has no HP pool (immortal boss, nobody takes damage). Modeled as always-live per the real-fight reading; the ONSET delay is unmodeled and unmeasured. FLAGGED.
burst Storm tick cadence (<= 7 ticks at 1s per cast) — it.skip: needs a per-source attribution field on damage events that the documented harness surface does not guarantee.
burst 'without restoring HP' — the absence of a heal/recovery emission is not observable (no recovery event kind); recorded in the spec, not asserted.
byFinalAtk vs static-ATK ranking — the kit says 'highest FINAL ATK' on all three target clauses (so byFinalAtk: true is required), but the two rankings cannot be discriminated in this fixture.
